title_ar: ضمن وفد  العلماء..الشيخ الددو يلتقي الرئيس أردوغان ويطالبه بقطع العلاقات مع الاحتلال
title_en: As Part of the Scholars' Delegation — Sheikh al-Dedew Meets President Erdoğan and Calls on Him to Sever Relations with the Occupation
body_ar:
طالب فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء بموريتانيا الرئيس التركي رجب طيب أردوغان بقطع العلاقات الدبلوماسية بين بلاده والاحتلال الإسرائيلي، وذلك خلال لقاء جمعه به اليوم ضمن وفد من علماء الأمة على هامش مهرجان جماهيري حاشد ترأسه الرئيس التركي اليوم السبت نصرة لغزة والمرابطين فيها..
وقد طالب وفد العلماء الرئيسَ التركي بمزيد من المواقف المشرفة تجاه غزة التي تتعرض للعدوان الصهيوني وحصاره منذ أكثر من 16 سنة.

وكان الرئيس التركي رجب طيب أردوغان قد أكد في مهرجان حاشد في مدينة اسطنبول دعا إليه سكان تركيا والمقيمين فيها على ضرورة وحدة المسلمين مؤكدا أن في الوحدة القوة وفي التفرق الضعف والضلال.

كما شدد خلال خطابه على شرعية المقاومة، وأن حماس حركة مقاوِمة للاحتلال، وليست حركة إرهابية كما يعتبرها البعض، متهما الغرب بالنفاق، ومحذرا الدول الغربية الداعمة للكيان الصهيوني من ازدواجية المعايير وغض الطرف عن الجرائم التي ترتكب في حق المسلمين وخاصة في غزة وفلسطين.
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, head of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars in Mauritania, called on the Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan to sever diplomatic relations between his country and the Israeli occupation, in the course of a meeting with him today as part of a delegation of the Ummah's scholars, on the margins of a mass public rally presided over by the Turkish President today, Saturday, in support of Gaza and of those holding the frontier there..
The delegation of scholars called on the Turkish President for further honourable stands towards Gaza, which has been subjected to Zionist aggression and its blockade for more than 16 years.

The Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan had affirmed, at a mass rally in the city of Istanbul to which he summoned the people of Turkey and those residing in it, the necessity of the unity of the Muslims, affirming that in unity there is strength and in division there is weakness and error.

In the course of his speech he also stressed the legitimacy of the resistance, and that Hamas is a movement resisting the occupation and not a terrorist movement as some regard it — accusing the West of hypocrisy, and warning the Western states that support the Zionist entity against double standards and against turning a blind eye to the crimes committed against Muslims, particularly in Gaza and Palestine.

flags.context: those in Gaza whom the rally was held in support of
options: those stationed in it in defence
flags.note: murābiṭūn is a term of art: those garrisoning a frontier of the Muslim lands, from ribāṭ. It is not a synonym for 'residents' or simply 'the steadfast'. Rendering it as 'fighters' would be wrong — it covers a civilian population held to be holding ground — but 'holding the frontier' does carry a martial sense that a reviewer should weigh.

flags.arabic: وأن حماس حركة مقاوِمة للاحتلال، وليست حركة إرهابية كما يعتبرها البعض
flags.context: the report's account of what President Erdoğan said in his speech
options: that Hamas is a movement resisting the occupation and not a terrorist movement as some regard it
that Hamas is a resistance movement against the occupation, not a terrorist organisation as some consider it
that Hamas resists the occupation and is not terrorist
flags.note: This sentence is attributed by the site's news desk to President Erdoğan, not to Sheikh al-Dedew, and the English must keep that attribution unmistakable. The word مقاوِمة carries a stray kasra in the source, an addslashes-adjacent CMS artefact preserved in body_ar. 'Organisation' is avoided for حركة because 'organisation' is the term of art in Western proscription regimes and would sharpen the sentence beyond what the Arabic says.

translator_notes: A news report by the site's news desk. Two distinct speakers are reported: the Sheikh, who called on the President to sever relations, and the President, whose speech the second half summarises. The site must not let the President's words read as the Sheikh's.
The body carries two stray vowel marks inside words (الرئيسَ, مقاوِمة) which are CMS artefacts. Preserved in body_ar, omitted from body_en, flagged per style guide section 11.
الكيان الصهيوني is rendered 'the Zionist entity' as the source has it, and الاحتلال الإسرائيلي as 'the Israeli occupation'. Neither has been neutralised and neither has been sharpened.
The doubled full stops in the first paragraph are in the source and are preserved.
editorial_review_reasons: The record reports a call on a head of state to sever diplomatic relations with Israel, and quotes President Erdoğan stating that Hamas is not a terrorist movement. Hamas is a proscribed organisation in the United Kingdom, the European Union, the United States and elsewhere, and publishing this material in English under Ummah Collective's name carries legal and reputational exposure in those jurisdictions, notwithstanding that the statement is reported speech by a third party and not the Sheikh's. Translated faithfully, neither softened nor strengthened; the publication decision belongs to Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office.
